messages:
sam.b (Sales): Meridian POC: low-load looks good but when they replay 80-120 concurrency we get TTFT spikes and occasional 429s. Evan, can you share quick repro details? :mag:

evan.c (Meridian): Repro at 16:20 UTC. Model redwood/medium-v2. Using default SDK; no prefill. Sample req: m-4451. Logs: `ERROR m-4451 429 soft_ratelimit` and some `first_byte_ms=410` outliers.

richa.k (Solutions): Likely queue saturation or KV cache misses. Tom, any shard metrics around 16:20?

tom.h (Oncall): s-22 had inflight surge and cache_miss spike. Autoscaler didn't add capacity due to bounded policy. Short fixes: cap client concurrency, enable prefix prefill, and tighten batch_window_ms.

anya.l (Runtime): Also recommend sending a warmup (prefill) job for the common prompt prefixes. We can push a warmup to s-22; ETA ~8min. Route hint header X-Redwood-Route: lowlat can help while warming.

evan.c (Meridian): We'll cap concurrency to 24 and add prefetch=2 now. Can you share the SDK snippet?

richa.k (Solutions): Snippet: ```js
client.generate({prefill:true, concurrency:24, prefetch:2, batch:{max_tokens:256, window_ms:20}})
```

meera.p (Account): Commercial: for production predictability Dedicated avoids these soft limits. We can offer a 48-hour Dedicated trial for evaluation; onboarding ~2-3 business days. I'll DM pricing ranges.

ops-bot: warmup job wu-231 queued -> running on shard s-22

tom.h (Oncall): Warmup running. I'll watch for 429s and first-byte outliers for 30m. If regressions persist, we can request a temporary increase to shard max_inflight (ops approval required).

evan.c (Meridian): Warmup finished. Replayed load: median first_byte ~110ms, 429s gone. Thanks team. Meera, please send trial info.

meera.p (Account): Sending Dedicated 48-hour trial T&Cs and cost delta now.

sam.b (Sales): Closing loop 1 — great cross-team support. Evan will confirm trial acceptance.
